script: Decision: requires further review. The claimant reports soot on the sofa and curtains, but CA-HO4-SMOKE requires sudden accidental smoke damage and excludes smoke from agricultural smudging or industrial operations. The cause and whether the damage was sudden and accidental remain unknown. Next action: Obtain available incident details or inspection findings to determine the smoke source and whether the damage was sudden and accidental.
